title: Local model Compose profiles

context.summary: Wire supported local model catalog entries into Compose profiles and installer profile resolution.
context.background: TASK-122 added the local model runner catalog. The next step is to make supported local runner profiles healthchecked and driven by installer-generated config.

in: Resolve supported local model Compose profiles from LOCAL_MODEL_RUNNER_CATALOG.
Add model data directories to the single-home layout and release manifest.
Add/strengthen healthchecks for local-models and Ollama profiles.
Make the local MVP model profile enable text/image embeddings, OCR, ASR, vision and face roles through @mindory/llm.
Add validation and docs for the supported local model Compose profiles.
out: Adding heavy runner images for experimental catalog entries.
Changing API or worker document behavior.

acceptance_criteria: Installer composeProfilesForAnswers resolves local-http and ollama profiles from LOCAL_MODEL_RUNNER_CATALOG.
Installer health wait maps supported local model profiles to their Compose services from the catalog.
MINDORY_HOME includes data/models and data/ollama in installer and release manifests.
local-models and ollama Compose services have healthchecks and persistent bind mounts under MINDORY_HOME.
The local MVP model profile routes text/image embeddings, OCR, ASR, vision captioning and face roles through local-http @mindory/llm settings.
pnpm local-model-profiles:validate, pnpm tasks:validate and pnpm check pass before merge.

manual_checks: Confirm docker-compose.yml does not add direct model calls outside @mindory/llm runtime configuration.

risks: Ollama model pulls remain explicit; the Compose service healthcheck validates the runner, not a specific model download.
definition_of_done: Branch is committed and merged back into master.
